title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional North African stew originating from Tunisia, made with tender lamb and aromatic spices. This recipe is a flavorful and aromatic representation of the country's rich culinary heritage.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the apricots, water, and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Skim off any excess fat and serve hot.
